subject.title: Subagent announce give-up (retry-limit/expiry) does not wake parent waiting on sessions_yield → permanent deadlock

question: Should this issue be resolved first by the narrow blocked-delivery wake PR, by the broader durable announcement queue design, or by bundling retry/expiry config into the same fix?
rationale: The core bug is source-reproducible, but the issue also requests new config surface and has multiple overlapping open fix/design paths; maintainer intent is needed to choose the product boundary before closing the issue.

options.title: Land Narrow Wake First
options.body: Review and land or replace the focused blocked-delivery wake fix, keeping durable queues and retry/expiry config as separate follow-up decisions.

options.title: Wait For Durable Queue
options.body: Pause narrow fixes until the persisted announcement queue design is accepted, which may solve more failure modes but is broader and riskier.

options.title: Bundle Config Knobs
options.body: Require the same fix to expose retry/expiry settings, accepting new public config surface and migration/docs obligations.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Wake First
recommendation.body: Review and land or replace the focused blocked-delivery wake fix, keeping durable queues and retry/expiry config as separate follow-up decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent lifecycle ownership signals make this the best available routing owner for the product boundary choice.
